status: draft 2026-10-07 (step 2.3, stage 1, revised after review) — not wired into the build yet; tagger: tools/tag.mjs

matching.tokens: lowercase; split on non-alphanumerics, camelCase and letter/digit boundaries (PillNav → pill nav, menu3 → menu 3, 3d → 3 d); aliases are tokenised the same way
matching.glued_words: some registries glue words (mynaui: appheaders1, dropdownmenu3); the common glued spellings are listed as aliases rather than split by a dictionary
matching.stemming: an alias token matches a text token or its singular (navbars → navbar, heroes → hero, faqs → faq, boxes → box); plural aliases ('logos') match only the plural
matching.whole_tokens: aliases match whole token sequences only: 'nav' matches floating-nav, never canvas
matching.longest_match: an alias span inside a longer alias span of another element is dropped ('pricing table' → pricing, not table; 'hero header' → hero, not navbar); identical spans tag every element that lists them ('sidebar nav' → sidebar + navbar)
matching.exclude: per element: an alias match inside one of the element's exclude phrases is dropped ('faq-keyboard-nav' → no navbar)
matching.with_tail: in a name or title, element aliases after the first 'with' are features, not the item's element ('card-with-header' → card, 'footer-with-nav' → footer); variants still match there
matching.weak_aliases: an element's weak aliases ('header' for navbar) count only in the slug/name, only when no other element matches in that name, and never when the name or title contains one of the element's exclude phrases ('header-1' titled 'Page header with tabs' → no navbar; 'chat-header' → chat)
matching.asset_gate: icons and illustrations are not UI elements: items named icon-* / icons-* and items of registries whose entry type is icon-set or asset-library get no element (before Phase 2B the entry type comes from overrides.json items.<id>.type)
matching.type_gate: registry items of type registry:hook | lib | style | theme | font | file never get an element
matching.fields: elements from slug/name + title; variants from name + title and only on items that already carry the element; the description is a search field, never a tag source
matching.variant_aliases: variants are read only on items that already carry the element, so a single word is fine when it names the variant inside that element ('columns' on a footer); words that there mostly mean something else are left out ('store' on an ecommerce navbar, 'grid' on a hero, 'panel' on a split CTA)
matching.overrides: overrides.json components["<domain>/<item name>"] = { elements, variants } replaces the computed tags of one item; use it for one-off misses, not for patterns
matching.standalone_variants: a variant marked standalone (all its aliases) or with standalone_aliases (only those) also tags its element on its own ('mega menu' → navbar + mega-menu, 'dock' → navbar + dock); variants that are also kinds of their own (sidebar, menubar, tabs, breadcrumbs) are not standalone, so 'sidebar-nav' is a sidebar and 'menubar' is not a navbar

categorize.rule: an entry's categories are the ids whose from_labels hold one of its source labels, in source order, at most 2. drop_labels are report sections, not categories. An entry left without a category (repo_label alone, or only drop_labels) is matched on its name, description, title and labels: design-rules when a design_rules_words phrase occurs together with a design_words token (an agent skill about SEO is not a design rule), else the first two other categories whose aliases occur (ignoring text_ignore_aliases, too generic outside design apps: cline is an 'IDE extension'), else default. overrides.json items.<id>.categories (ids) win over all of this.

elements.label: Navbar

variants.label: Mega menu

variants.label: Sidebar navigation

variants.definition: The menu opens as a full-screen overlay.

variants.label: Mobile / bottom nav
variants.definition: Mobile navigation: hamburger menu, bottom tab bar, slide-in mobile menu.

variants.label: Sticky

variants.label: Floating

variants.label: Pill
variants.definition: Links in a pill-shaped container or with pill highlights.

variants.label: Dock

variants.label: With search
